bias.label: Flat at 3,550-3,580 under 3,600; downtrend holds below 3,651

event: Today, Fri 27 Nov: US half-day (stocks close 20:00 SAST), thin trade. Sun 29 Nov: OPEC+ meeting. Mon 30 Nov: month end. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST, with a hike widely expected.

bullets.title: Quiet Asian open
bullets.text: Spot gold was around 3,565 early in Friday's Asian session (01:37 SAST), little changed after slipping toward 3,550 overnight (FXStreet via TMGM).

bullets.title: Bounce still capped
bullets.text: Thursday's attempt above 3,600 failed and price ended near 3,568, down about 0.6% on the day (TipRanks).

bullets.title: Hike next month
bullets.text: Markets expect the Fed to raise rates in December and again in early 2027, which keeps the dollar firm and gold heavy (FXStreet).

bullets.title: Near oversold
bullets.text: The daily RSI is about 31, close to oversold, so sharp short bounces are possible even inside the downtrend (FXStreet).

bullets.title: Tariff headlines
bullets.text: New US tariff moves on China, the EU, Mexico and Japan add headline risk in both directions (FXStreet, citing WSJ).

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: US markets open only for a half-day today, so moves can be jumpy and breakouts less reliable.
